integrity: Exact Gaussian covariance identity and strict-concavity proof are provided; companion checker uses standard-library exact fractions and independent Gaussian matrix inversion. Computation is supplemental, not a proof of all-dimensional uniqueness. Publication priority is provisional and no external mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Standard tensor Brownian sheet only; exactly one complete axis-normal hyperplane integral in each direction; independent Gaussian errors and a single total precision budget; nonadaptive Bayes squared loss for scalar volume integral. No claim for oblique or partial slices, arbitrary priors, other losses or multiple slices per axis.
title: Globally optimal precision allocation for Brownian-sheet hyperplane quadrature
